Local EventBus callback publish queues success callbacks for platform events that carry EventUuid.

source.content: public class PublishCallback implements eventbus.EventPublishSuccessCallback { public static Integer successCount = 0; public void onSuccess(eventbus.SuccessResult result) { successCount = result.getEventUuids().size(); } }

@isTest private class CoreRuntimeEventBusCallbacksTest { @isTest static void callbackPublishUsesEventUuid() { Event_Recipes_Demo__e event = (Event_Recipes_Demo__e) Event_Recipes_Demo__e.SObjectType.newSObject(null, true); System.assertNotEquals(null, event.EventUuid); Test.startTest(); Database.SaveResult single = EventBus.publish(event, new PublishCallback()); System.assert(single.isSuccess()); List<Database.SaveResult> many = EventBus.publish(new List<SObject>{event}, new PublishCallback()); System.assertEquals(1, many.size()); System.assert(many[0].isSuccess()); Test.stopTest(); System.assertEquals(1, PublishCallback.successCount); } }
